name: Cannes Lions 2027
job: Help creative professionals assess hypothetical session, meeting and travel tradeoffs while distinguishing festival access from awards-entry and programme rules.
source_notes: The organiser press page lists Cannes Lions 21–25 June 2027. Separate talent-programme terms say 21–26 June; their scope may differ. Do not assume the 26th is a general festival day. The full 2027 programme, pass rights, prices and session schedules require confirmation.
